name: io.github.sweesama/favicondl
title: FaviconDL
description: Extract a website favicon via the free FaviconDL API. Pass size 16, 32, 48, 64, 128, 180, 192, 256 or 512 for an exact square PNG; other numbers snap to the nearest. Omit size for the original file. Small rasters are upscaled and may look soft. No API key.
